name: tmplshort_diagnose
description: Say what state this server is in: its name, its version and the runtime it runs on. Changes nothing.

name: tmplshort_work
description: Count to a number, a step every tenth of a second, as a job: answers with the count when it ends within the wait, or with the running job to read as a resource.

upTo.description: The number to count to, 1 to 600.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the count before answering with the job in flight; 0 answers at once.
